notes: No-entry rises one 5m bar before the 23:20 cutoff because canonical Pine tests time_close + chartMs >= noEntryCutoff.
Forced-exit condition rises one 5m bar before the 23:45 cutoff because canonical Pine tests tc < exitCutoff and tc + chartMs >= exitCutoff.
A live position is therefore first force-closed on the bar labeled 23:35 in Strategy Tester, whose time_close is 23:40.
